À venda na Feira de Porto Sereia..en: For sale at the Porto Sereia Fair.

Presente das rendeiras da Cidade Coral..en: A gift from the lacemakers of Cidade Coral.

Prêmio por vencer o Conselho dos Guardiõ.en: Prize for beating the Council of Guardians.

Lembrança da primeira viagem no Trem Ser.en: A souvenir from your first ride on the Serra-Sol Train.

A Mãe diz que protege a casa..en: Mom says it protects the house.

À venda na Venda da Vila Buriti..en: For sale at the Vila Buriti Shop.

À venda na Feira da Cidade Ginga..en: For sale at the Cidade Ginga Fair.

Cuia de cabaça entalhada, com trançado d.en: A carved calabash gourd wrapped in woven straw. Seals a partnership with wild creatures.

Trançado reforçado de buriti. Segura mel.en: Reinforced buriti weave. Holds better than a regular Gourd.

Banhada em ouro de aluvião. Ótima chance.en: Plated in river gold. A great chance to catch.

Forrada com rede de pesca. Excelente con.en: Lined with fishing net. Excellent against River and Bug creatures.

Pintada com jenipapo. Excelente durante.en: Painted with genipap dye. Excellent at night.

Leve como pena. Excelente se arremessada.en: Light as a feather. Excellent if thrown on the very first turn.

Untada com mel de jataí. A criatura capt.en: Coated in jataí honey. The caught creature arrives friendly and bonds faster.

Obra dos antigos Guardiões. Nunca falha..en: Made by the ancient Guardians. Never fails. Only three exist in the world.

Chazinho morno. Recupera 20 de vida..en: A warm little tea. Restores 20 HP.

Mistura de raízes da feira. Recupera 50.en: A blend of roots from the market. Restores 50 HP.

Óleo raro da floresta. Recupera toda a v.en: A rare forest oil. Restores all HP.

Pasta de ervas. Cura queimadura, congela.en: An herbal paste. Cures burns, freezing and paralysis.

Cura qualquer status e também a confusão.en: Cures any status and confusion too.

Forte de acordar qualquer um: reanima um.en: Strong enough to wake anyone: revives a fainted creature with half its HP.

Caldo de cana gelado. Restaura 10 PG de.en: Iced sugarcane juice. Restores 10 MP to one move.

Restaura todos os PG de todos os golpes..en: Restores all MP to all moves.

Doce de dar sustança: a criatura sobe um.en: A hearty sweet: the creature goes up a level.

Repelente: por 100 passos, criaturas mai.en: Repellent: for 100 steps, creatures weaker than your lead won't appear.

Leva de volta à entrada de cavernas e ma.en: Takes you back to the entrance of caves and thick forests.

Pedra morna que guarda a luz do meio-dia.en: A warm stone that holds the midday light. Makes certain creatures evolve.

Pedra lisa que pulsa com as marés. Faz c.en: A smooth stone that pulses with the tides. Makes certain creatures evolve.

Pedra pálida que brilha no escuro. Faz c.en: A pale stone that glows in the dark. Makes certain creatures evolve.

Folha de uma árvore mais velha que as ci.en: A leaf from a tree older than the towns. Makes certain creatures evolve.

Peça da antiga ferrovia. Faz certas cria.en: A part from the old railway. Makes certain creatures evolve.

Ouro de garimpo. Vale um bom dinheiro na.en: Prospector's gold. Worth good money at the Shop.

Pena bonita achada no chão. Colecionador.en: A pretty feather found on the ground. Collectors pay well.

Concha de brilho furta-cor. Vende-se bem.en: An iridescent shell. Sells well at the fairs.

Petisco crocante. A criatura fica mais a.en: A crunchy snack. The creature grows friendlier.

Suculento. Recupera 10 de vida. Quem seg.en: Juicy. Restores 10 HP. The holder eats it on its own when its HP drops to half.

Docinha, direto do tronco. Cura envenena.en: Sweet, straight off the trunk. Cures poison.

Cheiro forte de acordar a vizinhança. Cu.en: A smell strong enough to wake the neighbors. Cures sleep.

Fruto quente do cerrado. Cura congelamen.en: A warm fruit from the cerrado. Cures freezing.

Energia da floresta. Restaura 10 PG de u.en: Forest energy. Restores 10 MP to one move.

Rádio e telefone de bolso: contatos, pro.en: Pocket radio and phone: contacts, shows and the clock.

Caderno da Profª Ipê para registrar as c.en: Prof. Ipê's notebook for recording Pingorama's creatures.

Leve e resistente. Anda bem mais rápido.en: Light and sturdy. Much faster than walking.

Vara de bambu remendada. Pesca o que dá..en: A patched bamboo rod. Catches whatever bites.

Vara firme, de bom anzol. Pesca criatura.en: A sturdy rod with a good hook. Catches better creatures.

A vara dos velhos pescadores. Pesca as r.en: The old fishers' rod. Catches the rare ones.

Passe da Maria-Fumaça que liga a Costa d.en: A pass for the steam train linking Costa do Sol to Sertão das Névoas.

Bilhete permanente do Saveiro que cruza.en: A permanent ticket for the Saveiro that crosses the bay.

Ovo morno de casca pintadinha que a Prof.en: A warm, speckled egg that Prof. Ipê asked you to take to Seu Aroeira.

Carta do Dudu, de Vila Jacarandá, para o.en: A letter from Dudu, of Vila Jacarandá, to his sailor dad in Porto Sereia.

Resposta do Marinheiro Bartô para o filh.en: Sailor Bartô's reply to his son Dudu, in Vila Jacarandá.

Chapéu de palha da Vó Zica, que o vento.en: Grandma Zica's straw hat, which the wind blew down to the pier.

Tira fotos de qualquer cena. As melhores.en: Takes photos of any scene. The best go in the album.

Invento do Faroleiro Volta. Quem fica na.en: Lightkeeper Volta's invention. Benched creatures 2 or more levels behind your strongest (5 after the League) get half the battle's experience.

Com uma parceira de Mata, Inseto ou Ging.en: With a Grass, Bug or Brawl partner, cuts through thick vines.

Com uma parceira de Rio, a canoa cruza a.en: With a River partner, the canoe crosses the water.

Com uma parceira de Terra, Pedra ou Ging.en: With an Earth, Stone or Brawl partner, pushes boulders.

Com uma parceira de Brasa, Trovão ou Enc.en: With an Ember, Thunder or Charm partner, lights up caves and fog.

Com uma parceira de Pedra, Terra, Ferro.en: With a Stone, Earth, Iron or Brawl partner, smashes cracked rocks.

Com uma parceira de Ginga, Comum ou Inse.en: With a Brawl, Normal or Bug partner, climbs creeper-covered cliffs.

Com uma parceira de Rio ou Lenda, sobe c.en: With a River or Legend partner, climbs waterfalls.

Com uma parceira de Rio, mergulha nas ág.en: With a River partner, dives into marked deep water.

Com uma parceira de Vento, voa entre as.en: With a Wind partner, flies between towns you've visited.

Com uma parceira muito amiga, itens e cr.en: With a very friendly partner, hidden items and creatures sparkle.

Pergaminho de Técnica reutilizável. Ensi.en: Reusable Technique Scroll. Teaches {golpe} to a compatible creature.

Prêmio do Quiz do Rádio. Libera os progr.en: The Radio Quiz prize. Unlocks Rádio Cipó's extra shows: Legend Songs, music from places you've visited and catching tips in Critter of the Day.

Fruto de cuieira amarelo-ovo. O artesão.en: An egg-yellow calabash. The craftsman turns it into a Swift Gourd.

Fruto de cuieira escuro e pesado. O arte.en: A dark, heavy calabash. The craftsman turns it into a Heavy Gourd.

Fruto de cuieira branco como a lua. O ar.en: A calabash white as the moon. The craftsman turns it into a Moon Gourd.

Fruto de cuieira verde-folha. O artesão.en: A leaf-green calabash. The craftsman turns it into a Friend Gourd.

Fruto de cuieira azulado, cheiro de rio..en: A bluish calabash that smells of the river. The craftsman turns it into a Lure Gourd.

Fruto de cuieira vermelho-urucum. O arte.en: An annatto-red calabash. The craftsman turns it into a Level Gourd.

Fruto de cuieira rosado. O artesão faz d.en: A pinkish calabash. The craftsman turns it into a Love Gourd.

Cuia artesanal leve como pluma. Muito bo.en: A handmade gourd light as a feather. Great against fast creatures that keep running off.

Cuia artesanal de casca grossa. Quanto m.en: A thick-shelled handmade gourd. The heavier the creature, the better it holds.

Cuia artesanal pintada de branco. Muito.en: A handmade gourd painted white. Great for creatures that evolve with stones or only at night.

Cuia artesanal forrada de paina. A criat.en: A handmade gourd lined with kapok fluff. The caught creature arrives very friendly.

Cuia artesanal com cheiro de isca. Ótima.en: A handmade gourd that smells like bait. Great for creatures hooked while fishing.

Cuia artesanal de urucum. Quanto mais fo.en: A handmade annatto gourd. The stronger your creature is than the wild one, the better it holds.

Cuia artesanal enfeitada de fitas. Muito.en: A handmade gourd decorated with ribbons. Great if the wild one is the same species and opposite sex as yours.

Frasco de vidro grosso com rolha de cort.en: A thick glass flask with a cork stopper, from the canoeist Seu Tarumã. Used to collect river water.

Água preta como café, colhida de noite n.en: Water black as coffee, collected at night from the bottom of Poço do Breu, on the Rio Cachoeira-Véu.

Água cor de barro, colhida de dia no poç.en: Clay-colored water, collected by day from the waterfall pool on Estrada Vermelha.

Lanterna de vidro verde da expedição da.en: A green-glass lantern from Dr. Solveig's expedition. Lit together atop the Peak at night, they call the northern sky.

Cuia de palha de buriti do Parque Safári.en: A buriti-straw gourd from the Safari Park. Only works inside and is returned at the exit.

Seixo liso e pesado, rolado pela corrent.en: A smooth, heavy pebble rolled by the current. The Safari owner wants to pave the lagoon's edge with it.

Mudinha de buriti num saco de estopa mol.en: A buriti seedling in a wet burlap sack. Where there's buriti, there's water.

Pedaço de tronco ocado pelo tempo, leve.en: A log hollowed out by time, light and sturdy. A ready-made home for those who like the dark.

Batida grossa de abacate. Fortalece a Vi.en: A thick avocado shake. Boosts the creature's HP (effort).

Banana com leite e aveia. Fortalece o At.en: Banana with milk and oats. Boosts the creature's Attack (effort).

Mamão batido bem gelado. Fortalece a Def.en: Ice-cold blended papaya. Boosts the creature's Defense (effort).

Graviola cremosa. Fortalece o Ataque Esp.en: Creamy soursop. Boosts the creature's Sp. Attack (effort).

Manga espada batida. Fortalece a Defesa.en: Blended mango. Boosts the creature's Sp. Defense (effort).

Guaraná batido com fruta. Fortalece a Ve.en: Guaraná blended with fruit. Boosts the creature's Speed (effort).

Garrafada curtida com casca de jatobá e.en: Root tonic aged with jatobá bark and honey. Restores 120 HP.
